entities.summary: Ghurid, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Ghaznavid and Ghurid Empires (1148–1215). Preceded by Ghurid Dynasty and Delhi Sultanate Origins and Delhi Sultanate. Their legacy influenced Kartid dynasty rules Herat as Mongol vassals, preserving Persian culture.
